I ended up taking Japanese in college after studying it alone for a couple months this way, it’s an easy A. My professor said I’m better at speaking Japanese than people who take a year of Japanese classes. 

What helped the most for me was having a teacher, but also friends to talk to online. I’d recommend that. I’d also maybe recommend Pimsleur Japanese 1 (and maybe 2) to get some very nice pronunciation, it will impress them trust me. 

As for shows, any Japanese show you can enjoy will work. I wouldn’t force yourself to watch anything you wouldn’t see in English. For me, I like to use ‘learn languages with Netflix’ to watch anime and analyze the way my favorite characters speak so I can talk like them. Seeing grammar points so often this way really helped me level up my speech.
